name: Purogé
tagline: Natural fiber, explained. Linen for work and travel.
description: The Purogé Journal explains why natural-fiber clothing matters for your body and the planet, and how to wear linen well at work and on the road.

author.name: Rogenie
author.bio: Rogenie founded Purogé, named for her grandmothers Lola Purisima and Lola Roberta, who sewed and sold clothes for a living. She writes about natural fiber, fit and buying fewer, better pieces.

dedication: Named for Lola Purisima and Lola Roberta, who sewed and sold clothes for a living.
